title.zh: Proposed stablecoin rules might guarantee your dollar while making you wait a week to spend it
title.en: Proposed stablecoin rules might guarantee your dollar while making you wait a week to spend it

current_state.zh: The OCC has proposed stablecoin redemption rules allowing two-business-day processing with a seven-day extension during redemption surges exceeding 10% of outstanding issuance, raising questions about whether conversion providers can bridge liquidity gaps.
current_state.en: The OCC has proposed stablecoin redemption rules allowing two-business-day processing with a seven-day extension during redemption surges exceeding 10% of outstanding issuance, raising questions about whether conversion providers can bridge liquidity gaps.
